subject: general
question:
How many squares are there in the given figure? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b86279fc871ae11549cdb85c4429a6407b2406c24be1808ee9b3679f35c355a.png]
solution:
The number of squares in the given figure is shown below:

1) Total number of squares = (m × n) + (m - 1)(n - 1) + (m - 2)(n - 2)

where, n = rows and m = columns

So, Total number of squares = (3 × 5) + (3 - 1)(5 - 1) + (3 - 2)(5 - 2) ⇒ 15 + (2 × 4) + (1 × 3) ⇒ 15 + 8 + 3 = 26

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0159c1f274f1ce9f9f792ed4949d6f1fd71b95a49959313991d93be1a6150b7.png] 

2) Total number of squares = 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d416ccdce75f321fe6ee56e7cabb813a05c743f6863f409ea28b38f19716b0fa.png] 

Thus, **total number of squares = (26 + 6) = 32**

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
